title: kotgent project file
description: A `.kotgent.json` committed at a project root. It names the project ONCE, with a uuid, so that a repository and every `git worktree` of it share one backlog instead of one per path. kotgent writes this file on the first `kotgent task add` in a location that has no project, and never commits it.

$schema.description: This schema's URL. Ignored by kotgent's reader; present so an editor can validate the file.

id.description: The project's identity: a canonical 8-4-4-4-12 uuid. Compared case-insensitively on read and stored lower-cased, because SQLite compares the column binary.

name.description: The project's display name. Trimmed on read, so surrounding whitespace is not significant; control characters are refused because the value reaches a terminal, a notification and the board.
